scope: Only new src/ui/styles/marina-mobile.css; no other CSS or JavaScript edited. No browser used.
implemented: Bounded 42dvh/325px top drawer, one internal panel scroll, 54px collapsed tab strip, 44px Scenes/Layers/toggle targets.
Two-row playback: four 44px buttons then 44px scrub/clock row. Compact accessible name/save grid and saved-scene picker.
Fixed safe-area bottom composer; primary row does not shrink and sits below scrollable 90px results. Inputs use 16px text to avoid focus zoom; cancel/retry stay in their own row.
Geometry separates composer, source-credit strip and command dock without raising z-index.
Plugin rows use minmax(0,1fr), wrapping and layout/paint containment. Native closed details hide descendants and shrink the dock hit region.
Closed secondary panels removed from layout, active panels bounded, decorative HUD compacted while keeping navigation and source attribution.
Dvh/short-height fallbacks constrain the drawer/results when viewport space contracts.

validation.method: PostCSS parse + static contract assertions; no browser per coordinator instruction

limitations: Coordinator must import marina-mobile.css LAST after desktop styles; this agent did not edit the import file.
No screenshot, real 375x739 rendering, hit-test or interaction test performed; coordinator owns browser validation.

CSS cannot read visualViewport.offsetTop/height. Dvh follows keyboard resizing only where the browser resizes the CSS viewport; overlay-only iOS keyboards need a coordinator-owned JS visualViewport bridge or interactive-widget viewport policy.
Existing full-width chat intentionally retains priority over the incident composer at <=640px; floating plugins are hidden during chat.
Agent 9 currently exposes data-expanded and hidden state; body.scene-drawer-collapsed is additionally supported if the coordinator module applies it.
